description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. HUC12, HUC14 and HUC16 watershed polygons form nested spatial inputs for the NPDES Phase I stormwater outfall and discharge-point mapping programme. The native layers expose polygon geometry and named attributes, including HUC16, HUC14, Name, GNIS_ID, Acres, HUC12. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for network flow studies. The three hierarchy layers are grouped using their shared Phase I programme and explicit HUC parent identifiers; boundaries do not by themselves establish pipe connectivity or flow measurements. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
